items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: One time I had played with this veteran fiddler, Claude “Fiddler” Williams.

ctx.x: I don’t know. I don’t know. That’s interesting to find out, the origin of the phrase.
